personal_information.professional_title: IT Executive | Systems Automation & RPA Development

professional_summary: Results-driven IT Executive with over 12 years of experience, specializing in developing custom automation solutions and managing enterprise IT infrastructure. Expert in Robotic Process Automation (RPA) using UiPath to automate business processes and integrate systems. Proven expertise in leveraging PHP, Python, and PowerShell to build internal platforms and streamline operations. Holds key responsibilities in maintaining ISMS ISO/IEC 27001:2022 compliance and managing monitoring/security tools. Seeking to apply a unique blend of software development, RPA, and systems administration skills to drive digital transformation.

achievements: Manage and maintain the company's AS400-based ERP solution, ensuring high availability and performance for all business operations.
Designed, developed, and deployed full-stack internal web applications using PHP, MySQL, and Apache to address critical business needs.
Engineered automated data pipelines by creating Python scripts (executed via Windows Task Scheduler) to extract data from AS400 DB2 via ODBC, transforming it into JSON for live dashboard consumption.
Utilize PowerShell scripting to automate user and resource management in Active Directory and DHCP, significantly reducing manual administrative tasks.

Administer a suite of IT management and security tools including Endpoint Central, Desktop Service Plus, Log360, and Event Analyzer for centralized monitoring, patch management, and security incident analysis.
Play a key role in maintaining and auditing the company's Information Security Management System (ISMS) aligned with the ISO/IEC 27001:2022 standard.
Design, develop, and deploy Robotic Process Automation (RPA) solutions using UiPath to automate repetitive business processes, increasing operational efficiency and reducing manual errors.
Identify automation opportunities across departments and implement UiPath robots to handle rule-based tasks, data entry, and system integration workflows.
Configure and maintain Ubuntu environments using Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL) for development and data processing tasks.
Implement and configure Apache Superset for business intelligence and data visualization, creating interactive dashboards for various departments.
Spearheaded the development and maintenance of the company website.
Managed, maintained, and troubleshooted the company-wide ERP system and MSSQL Server database.
Provided comprehensive technical support for operating systems, software, and hardware.
